name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)
description: If your Army Faction is **Death Guard**, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more *Death Guard* models from your army, it is Afflicted (see below).

abilities.name: Contagion Range
abilities.description: Contagion Range changes over the course of the battle: ![Contagion Range 1](/img/death-guard/contagion-range-1.webp) ![Contagion Range 2](/img/death-guard/contagion-range-2.webp) ![Contagion Range 3](/img/death-guard/contagion-range-3.webp)

abilities.name: Afflicted
abilities.description: During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.

subAbilities.name: Skullsquirm Blight
subAbilities.description: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

subAbilities.name: Rattlejoint Ague
subAbilities.description: Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

subAbilities.name: Scabrous Soulrot
subAbilities.description: Worsen the Move, Leadership, and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model's Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).

name: Pact of Decay
description: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select **Plague Legions** as your Army Faction.
